deviations.claim_in_article: “The surprise came halfway through the call.”
deviations.issue: Adds an unverified detail that the surprise or revelation occurred halfway through a real call; the Ledger confirms human handling of some calls, but gives no such timing.
deviations.explanation: The specific halfway-through-the-call detail is absent from the Ledger, so this is an unsupported new factual claim. No existing Ledger timing is changed, so changed_time is false.
